name: Ray Marching with Blinn-Phong Lighting
aliases: GPU Ray Marching with Signed Distance Fields
definition: A rendering technique that computes pixel colors by casting rays from a camera, marching them through a scene defined by implicit functions (SDFs), and applying a Blinn-Phong lighting model at the hit point.
summary: Ray Marching with Blinn-Phong Lighting renders scenes defined by Signed Distance Functions by casting rays to surface intersections and shading them with the Blinn-Phong model, differing from analytical ray tracing by using iterative distance estimation.
